report_comment.text: ZBTB16 encodes PLZF, a zinc-finger transcriptional repressor involved in development and differentiation. RARA encodes retinoic acid receptor alpha, a ligand-regulated nuclear-receptor transcription factor. ZBTB16::RARA is a rare RARA fusion associated with an APL-like leukemia phenotype. ZBTB16::RARA-positive variant APL usually fails to respond to tretinoin or arsenic trioxide.
